name: SendSignal Free Email
free_limit: 3,000 emails/month with REST API and SMTP relay, DKIM-verified sending domains, webhooks, templates, contacts, suppressions and test mode.
watch_out: Free is $0 forever and no card is required; sending pauses when the monthly quota is exhausted unless the account switches to a paid plan or optional pay-as-you-go. Inbound parsing and broadcasts/automations are on paid Pro. Confirm commercial-use policy directly.
